inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A model car play structure on the play ground has an exposed bolt where its tire has pulled away from the structure. on the same structure, there is a loose, broken wooden surface board on which children at play would step or stand. The is also an exposed stake protruding up 4 inches from the ground where the wooden bordering material has broken away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Written feeding instructions for two of the five infants in care did not have evidence of having been updated in the last month by parents. One of the child's written feeding instructions most recent update was 8/25/25 and the other child's was updated 9/8/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were found in an unlocked cupboard that was accessible to children in the School-age classroom. The  director's assistant moved these cleaning supplies to an area of the classroom that was inaccessible to children during my inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Rugs in the Infant, PreK 3, and PreK 4 classrooms were all found to be in need of cleaning/vacuuming. There were particles of crumbs, paper, dirt, and dead grass on the rugs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 10 children files reviewed did not provide current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: 4 out of 10 children files reviewed did not provide the required physician health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 2 out of 10 children files did not have the emergency contact information other than the parent listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 4 out of 10 children files did not have the emergency medical contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: 1 out 10 children files reviewed did not have weather the child swim with or without assistance on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: During staff file review, Director completed 29 hours of training for 2022-2023 calendar year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: During staff file review, 1 caregiver completed 9.5 hours of training for 2023-2024 calendar year. 1 caregiver completed 16.5 hours of training for 2023-2024 calendar year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: 1 out of 10 children files reviewed did not provide the required physician health statement after 1 year of being enrolled at center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Follow Up:     The loose-fill surfacing on the playground still  did not measure the proper depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill surfacing  on the playground did not measure the proper depth. Photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: In Pre-K (3)  classroom the television was sitting on a book case not anchored down. A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: In the infant classroom a crib was blocking the exit door. A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: In the 2's, Pre-School (3),  and school age classrooms I observed several walls with the paint peeling.Photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The CPSC was not available for review and was not posted. This was corrected at inspection when the director completed the annual certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There is no documentation that a fire drill has been conducted since August 2023. This was corrected at inspection when the director completed the monthly test and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There is no documentation that a smoke detector has been tested since August 2023.   A photo was taken of the form. This was corrected at inspection when the director completed the monthly test and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: A child was missing emergency contact address and phone number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One file was missing the affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: I observed on the toddler playground that trash and tree branches on the playground. On the school age playground trash was observed on the playground. This was corrected at inspection when the trash and tree branches were removed.     Photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver was not aware of the children's ages and did not have a sheet with the information available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Based on the preponderance of information obtained during the investigation there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that food was used as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS            investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that caregivers are yelling at children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, A caregiver did not walk through the operation's van prior to leaving the van unattended, which resulted in a child being left unsupervised in the van for approximately 20 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that the director did not verify that all minimum standard requirements are being met. The director is not ensuring the operation is always operating in compliance with the minimum standards. The director is not ensuring staff are properly trained or that staff are following the state regulations when transporting children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: Child's safety alarm is present on one of the vans, but not properly maintained, according to manufacturer's instruction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: The operations vehicle is not being always maintained in a safe operating condition because the safety belts were not working for children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care: The vehicle safety alarm was not being always used children were transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments: The van drivers were transporting children for the operation although they were not properly trained on how to provide the services for the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §746.1003(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, the operation did not report that a child was left unattended on a vehicle within two days as required. The incident occurred on 3/30/23 while a licensing inspector was on the premises. The operation failed to notify the inspector of the incident during the visit, nor was a report received regarding the incident within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation of neglectful supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A 14 month old infant was sitting at the high chair table and was not strapped in.   Note: A picture was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation for supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Length: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the training certificate was missing the length of the training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Length (26 TAC §746.1329(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Based on information obtained during the investigation, sign in and out sheets were not completed during the month of May 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there was no parent and emergency telephone numbers for the children that were being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there was no list in the vehicle of the children who were being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there was no emergency medical information for the  children that were being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: In the 1's classroom all the cots were not labeled with the children's  name. This was corrected at inspection when the director label all the cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: I observed a caregiver change a diaper and not wash the child's hand.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher was missing from the van. This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver replaced the missing fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: Hand washing sink was not observed in classroom where diaper changing is occurring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: In the infant classroom a crib was blocking the  marked fire exit door. A photo was taken and the crib was moved.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the infant classroom the window seal was covered in dirt.     On the school age playground the border to the playground nails were sticking up from the wood. A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infant feeding sheets were not updated within the 30-day requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: I observed that both playgrounds did not have enough loose fill on them. Photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the Pre-School room I observed several walls with the paint peeling. A photos were taken.       On the school age playground the stairs on the play structure was rusty and coming a loose from the structure. A photos were taken.    A nail was sticking out along the border leading to the toddler playground.  A photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
